subject.title: feat: open Control UI links in a macOS sidebar browser

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor an in-app macOS sidebar browser for external Control UI HTTP(S) links, or keep the current default-browser behavior?
rationale: This adds a new native external-content surface and host bridge in the macOS dashboard, and the protected maintainer label means automation should not decide the product or security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped two-PR implementation
options.body: Proceed with the issue's split plan: first add a dormant host-detected Control UI bridge, then add the macOS WKWebView sidebar with explicit controls and proof.

options.title: Keep default-browser behavior
options.body: Decline the in-app browser direction and keep off-origin dashboard links opening through the user's default browser.

options.title: Request a security/design spike
options.body: Ask for a minimal prototype or boundary note before accepting arbitrary external page loading inside the app.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped two-PR implementation
recommendation.body: Proceed with the issue's split plan: first add a dormant host-detected Control UI bridge, then add the macOS WKWebView sidebar with explicit controls and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the request and is the strongest recent history signal for macOS dashboard product direction.
